content.text: {"recommendedIde":"Bolt.new","recommendedVibe":"Bolt.new + Vite","rationale":"This is a one-shot prototype with a tightly scoped input/output surface (a form collecting budget, family size, and dietary constraints feeding a structured JSON response rendered as a meal plan and shopping list). Bolt.new's in-browser iteration loop lets a solo builder ship the full UI-to-LLM-to-display pipeline without any local tooling setup. Vite gives fast HMR for the React/TS front-end and keeps the bundle lean for what is essentially a single-page tool. The deal-breaker against Lovable+Supabase is that there is no persistent user data or auth requirement here — the output is ephemeral and per-session — so a database layer adds friction with zero payoff.","alternatives":[{"name":"Lovable + Supabase","fit":0.72},{"name":"Replit + Vite + React","fit":0.65},{"name":"Claude Code + Python","fit":0.41}]}
